newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: Burmese leader to visit Cambodia Oct 16-19.
newsitem.headline: Burmese leader to visit Cambodia Oct 16-19.

text.p: The leader of Burma's military government, General Than Shwe, will fly to Phnom Penh next week for an official visit condemned by the Cambodian opposition.

Than Shwe, chairman of Burma's State Law and Order Restoration Council (SLORC), will meet King Norodom Sihanouk, co-Premiers Prince Norodom Ranariddh and Hun Sen and other officials during the October 16-19 visit, an official statement said on Thursday.
Burmese Foreign Minister Ohn Gyaw and his counterpart Ung Huot will preside over the first meeting of a joint commission on bilateral cooperation on October 17, said the statement.
The commission was agreed on during Ranariddh's visit to Burma in January. Burma reopened diplomatic relations with Cambodia in 1994.
The two sides are scheduled to sign agreements on tourism and airline cooperation.

Sam Rainsy, head of the opposition Khmer Nation Party, has criticised plans to invite Than Shwe to Cambodia and in May said the government should support the democratic movement of Aung San Suu Kyi rather than the "illegal and barbarous regime of Rangoon".
The former finance minister, whose party is not recognised by the government, met Aung San Suu Kyi during a visit to Burma in August.
